All 60 tests pass (26 new prefilter + 34 pre-existing). Here's a summary of what was done:

---

**`origit/tests/test_prefilter.py`** — 26 tests covering:
- [`rule_new_dependency`](origit/origit/prefilter.py:75): fires on dep, empty → no findings
- [`rule_external_read`](origit/origit/prefilter.py:82): URL fires, MCP fires, file kind ignored
- [`rule_commands`](origit/origit/prefilter.py:89): fires with commands, empty → no findings
- [`rule_agent_config_changed`](origit/origit/prefilter.py:96): `AGENTS.md` fires, `.bob/` fires, non-config paths ignored
- [`rule_hidden_text`](origit/origit/prefilter.py:103): Unicode-tag smuggled sentence built from ASCII (+0xE0000) — decoded sentence appears in evidence; zero-width; bidi; clean text ignored
- [`rule_secrets_touched`](origit/origit/prefilter.py:117): `.env` wrote, `.pem` changed, `id_rsa` read, non-secret ignored
- [`rule_dependency_not_read`](origit/origit/prefilter.py:121): fires when no docs read, suppressed by matching file ref, suppressed by URL containing name, empty deps
- [`run()`](origit/origit/prefilter.py:144): sorted by severity descending, empty record → no findings
- [`needs_review()`](origit/origit/prefilter.py:151): `False` for empty list, `True` when findings present

**`origit/origit/prefilter.py`** — added:
- `rule_dependency_not_read`: emits `ASI04 medium CWE-829` for each `added_deps` entry whose `name` doesn't appear in any `read` ref of kind `file` or `url`
- Registered in `RULES`
- Docstring updated with the new trigger line

---

**Origit declaration**
read: `AGENTS.md`, `origit/origit/prefilter.py`, `origit/tests/test_record.py`
wrote: `origit/tests/test_prefilter.py`, `origit/origit/prefilter.py`
added_deps: none
commands: `cat > origit/tests/test_prefilter.py`, `python3 - (sed script for prefilter.py)`, `pytest -q`, `pytest -v tests/test_prefilter.py`
